questions.stem: A child with known case of bronchial asthma comes with respiratory distress with respiratory rate 48/min, cannot speak two words, occasional wheeze and oxygen saturation is 95%. You have given 3 doses of salbutamol by nebulization and patient get stabilised and now able to speak a sentence but oxygen saturation falls to 85% . What can be the most probable reason for fall in saturation?
